nodes.label: Jarz Digital Content Strategy
nodes.rationale: Scores are judgement calls without Search Console/keyword data; nothing invents results, and case studies wait for verifiable figures.

nodes.label: needsReview Flag for Drafted Content
nodes.rationale: Industry pages, project descriptions, service problems and legal placeholders had no original copy, so they were drafted and flagged; no results or metrics are claimed until verified.

nodes.label: Topic Scoring Model (impact/fit/search/ease)
nodes.rationale: Weighted 40/30/20/10; search scores are estimates to be confirmed with Keyword Planner.

nodes.label: Email OTP Codes (sign-up & reset)
nodes.rationale: 6-digit codes expire in 10 min, lock after 5 tries, stored only as HMAC hashes; reset responses never reveal whether an email exists. Config in src/config/otp.ts.

nodes.label: MongoDB-Backed Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Stored in the TTL-expired ratelimits collection so all serverless instances share limits.

nodes.label: Role-Based Permissions (ADMIN / EDITOR / USER)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth in src/lib/auth/permissions.ts; enforced in every layout, page, action and route handler, with the proxy only an optimistic first gate.

nodes.label: HMAC-Hashed Session Tokens
nodes.rationale: Browser holds only a random 256-bit token in an httpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; DB stores an HMAC keyed by AUTH_SECRET so a database leak cannot be replayed.

nodes.label: ISR & Tagged Cache Invalidation
nodes.rationale: Public pages prerendered with revalidate=3600 for ~20ms responses; every CMS mutation invalidates tags and paths so edits appear immediately.

nodes.label: Schema-Driven CMS
nodes.rationale: Each content type is declared once in src/lib/cms/resources.ts; that single definition drives admin list, editor form, Zod validation, slugs, draft/publish, public URLs and cache invalidation, so adding a type needs only a model, a registry entry and a server.ts mapping.

nodes.label: Jarz Teal #00AFB9 Brand Hue
nodes.rationale: Sampled from the original logo; all color scales built around it.

nodes.label: Motion Tokens & Reveals
nodes.rationale: Above-the-fold text uses CSS keyframes to animate on first paint without JavaScript; below-the-fold uses Motion components.

nodes.label: Jarz Digital Design System
nodes.rationale: Premium tech + creative agency direction: dark ink hero surfaces, restrained teal glow, large display type, motion only to communicate hierarchy.

nodes.label: Color Usage Rules (contrast, status never color-only)
nodes.norm_label: color usage rules (contrast, status never color-only)
nodes.rationale: Teal is accent not fill; gradients only teal->azure on small elements; no brand-400/500 text on white for contrast; status always paired with a text label.

nodes.label: Hub-and-Spoke Linking Rules
nodes.rationale: Each post links up to its hub service page and across to 1-2 posts in the same pillar; the post category drives automatic service box and Guides links.

nodes.label: Legacy WordPress 301 Redirects (src/config/redirects.ts)
nodes.rationale: Trailing-slash redirect disabled so every old URL is exactly one 301 hop; other /wp-content/* files return 410.

nodes.label: Exclusion of Unverified Claims
nodes.rationale: Template leftovers (e.g. 'Sarah', Digital Silk copy), unverifiable awards and stat blocks were not published; only site-wide repeated stats were kept and made editable in Admin -> Settings -> Homepage stats.

nodes.label: E-E-A-T Named Author Credit
nodes.rationale: Google rewards visible expertise; crediting SEO posts to the founder (12 years SEO, #1 Local SEO on Fiverr 2023) instead of 'Jarz Digital'.

nodes.label: Seed Content Fallback (src/content/seed)
nodes.rationale: If MONGODB_URI is empty the public site renders from migrated seed content, enabling DB-less preview; seed is also the source for db:seed.

nodes.label: Admin vs Public Visual Language
nodes.rationale: Admin deliberately looks like a SaaS tool (ink sidebar, mist-50 canvas, 16px cards, command palette); client portal sits between, keeping display type and 24px panels.
